thread:
incident-bot: P0 alert — unusual spike in 5xx + timeout rates for model-runner cluster us-east-1. Aggregate 5xx rate at 9.8% over last 3m, gateway latency rising. Auto-pager: paging oncall.
anya (oncall): I'm on it. seeing a lot of 502/5xx from model-runner-12 pods in us-east-1. Putting initial triage notes here.
simon (eng-runtime): Thanks. Any correlation with recent deploys? I see a quant-kernel update shipped last night to canary.
incident-bot: deploy-bot reported rollout: quant-kernel/v12 -> model-runner (canary -> us-east-1) at 2026-03-14T03:47Z. Canary success flagged but rollout continued at 04:30Z.
maria (sre): Customer-facing impact? John/CS, can you surface any active incidents?
john (customer-success): yes — two enterprise customers reporting elevated timeouts for chat completions. Reported ~15% user-facing errors starting ~04:45Z. They're seeing 5xx and UX timeouts. Escalated to enterprise AE.
anya (oncall): Metrics snapshot: 5xx rate by host:
- mr-12-0: 18%
- mr-12-1: 15%
- mr-11-2: 0.4% (healthy)
Heap/oom metrics: mr-12-* show rising RSS before crash. Logs show occasional 'segfault in attention_kernel.cu' and "double free" traces.
simon (eng-runtime): segfault in attention kernel + double free suggests new low-level kernel in v12 is unstable under certain large sequence lengths. Which model(s) are hot? any pattern by seq_len or kv-cache hits?
jessica (ml-infra): Heavy traffic is redwood/large-v2-q4 with avg seq_len 1536 for a handful of routes (batch inference, streaming chat). Smaller models not impacted so far. Prefix-cache hit rate dropped for those routes — maybe cache pressure + kernel path exposed.
anya (oncall): Immediate mitigation checklist I propose:
1) Pause rollout of quant-kernel/v12 in us-east-1 (deploy-bot rollback).
2) Reroute new requests away from mr-12 nodes to stable pool.
3) Temporarily pin enterprise customers to redwood/small-v1 for degraded latency.
4) Drain and reprovision affected nodes with v11 and run repro tests.
5) Postmortem ticket and customer comms.
maria (sre): I can run emergency firewall/routing to fail open to dedicated fallback cluster. If we need to reduce blast radius fast: scale down model-runner instances that have v12 and spin up v11 nodes.
simon (eng-runtime): Agree. Also suggest disabling kernel auto-quant path for large seq_len (>1024) if we can toggle at runtime.
ops-bot: Action created: #INC-3590001 - rollback quant-kernel/v12 in us-east-1. Assigned to simon (eng-runtime). ETA 10m.
incident-bot: All hands oncall: simon and anya are on primary, maria on infra, jessica on model mapping, john on external comms.
simon (eng-runtime): Rolling back canary -> issuing rollback job now: `deployctl rollback --service model-runner --release quant-kernel/v11 --region us-east-1`.
anya (oncall): While rollback runs, I'll shift traffic off mr-12 nodes: `rictl route update --selector node=mr-12 --weight 0` then `rictl route update --selector node=mr-11 --weight 1`.
jessica (ml-infra): I'll create a temporary route rule to pin enterprise tenants to redwood/small-v1 until we validate stability: `routectl add --tenant corp-acme --model redwood/small-v1 --ttl 1h`.
john (customer-success): Updating customers: sending note that we detected degraded performance and we're applying a temporary routing and rollback. ETA to stable: ~30-45m. Will update if ETA changes.
maria (sre): Observability: enabling verbose native-kernel logs on a single canary pod to capture stack traces post-rollback: `kubectl exec -c agent mr-12-0 -- journalctl -u model-runner -f --since "5m"` — capturing now.
simon (eng-runtime): Rollback job completed on control plane, starting node-level reconciliation. Kicking cordon/drain on mr-12-* and replacing with v11 images: `kubectl cordon mr-12-0 && kubectl drain mr-12-0 --ignore-daemonsets && kubectl apply -f mr-12-v11.yaml`.
ops-bot: Note: automated autoscaler triggered +3 mr-13 (v12) earlier — those new nodes are also subject to rollback policy; setting drain labels.
anya (oncall): After draining mr-12-0 we saw immediate drop in 5xx from that host to <1% — good sign. Total cluster 5xx dropped to 4.1%.
simon (eng-runtime): While draining we saw a reproducible crash with a long input batch >1200 tokens. Stack trace includes `attention_kernel::reduce_bias` and `free_buffer` path. Attaching snippet:
```
E model-runner: segfault at 0x7ff... in attention_kernel.cu:234
E backtrace: attention_kernel::reduce_bias() at attention_kernel.cu:234
E  free_buffer() at memory_pool.cu:87
E  double free detected
```
jessica (ml-infra): That matches the new fused attention path introduced in v12 that tries to free temp KV buffers earlier. Hypothesis: concurrent reuse + large sequence leads to double-free race.
anya (oncall): We're going to block the fused path via runtime flag while we finish rollback. simon, can you set `--disable-fused-attn` on running pods via configmap patch?
simon (eng-runtime): Patching configmap now: `kubectl patch configmap model-runner-config -p '{"data":{"DISABLE_FUSED_ATTN":"true"}}'` then rolling restart.
maria (sre): Observability after patch: 5xx dropped to 1.2% over 10m and latency back to normal baseline. Customers reporting reduced errors.
john (customer-success): Two enterprise customers ack'ed improved UX. One asked for root cause and ETA for permanent fix. I said we'll follow up in postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident timeline recorded. Severity: P1 -> downgraded to P2 after rollback and config patch.
anya (oncall): Next steps for post-incident:
- eng-runtime to produce reproducer and test coverage for fused-attn path under long seq and concurrency (simon + jessica).
- infra to add canary gating for kernel releases with seq_len stress tests (maria).
- CS to send post-incident customer note with mitigation actions and ETA for final fix (john).
- Ops to review autoscaler behavior that provisioned additional v12 nodes mid-rollout.
simon (eng-runtime): I'll open ENG-3592 with reproducer and include suggested patch to memory pool free ordering. Also plan unit/integration tests.
jessica (ml-infra): We'll add a workload test with seq_len up to 2048 and simulate kv-cache pressure before promoting quant-kernel rolls.
maria (sre): Scheduling a rollback blameless postmortem in the next 48h. I'll own runbook updates to add a quick toggle for fused-attn for future rollouts.
john (customer-success): Drafting customer comms now, will share for review. Notifying AE and legal for the two impacted enterprise accounts.
anya (oncall): Closing live mitigation: cluster stable, 5xx < 0.5% for last 15m. Leaving thread open for postmortem notes.
ops-bot: INC-3590001 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Close ETA 48h pending postmortem.
incident-bot: Reminder: add logs and stack traces to the incident ticket. Use tag #kernel-fused-attn and #quant-kernel/v12 in attachments. :white_check_mark:
